clips.title: The story
paras: Durnan's Scalding Mornbrew is a freshly poured, piping-hot dwarven beverage intended for Durnan Furcutter in Coldridge Valley. Because the drink quickly loses its heat in the frigid mountain air, it must be rushed directly to Anvilmar before it goes cold.

In the biting chill of Coldridge Valley, few comforts rival a mug of fresh mornbrew served piping hot. When a courier gets delayed delivering a round to Grelin Whitebeard, the fresh cup meant for Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar risks freezing over. Durnan specifically expects his brew scalding, leaving only a short window of a few minutes to carry the steaming mug up the snowy path into the mountain hall before it cools completely.
